dataList.panicName: The Obsidian God - The Giant of Le Noir - The Chaplain - Les Marteaux
dataList.flavor:
Time passes at a tremendous pace within the Sisyphe System, unhindered by material resistance. Yet through their respective viewpoints, the Giants can synchronize themselves with the System's internal flow of time and communicate with its customers.

Among them, the Giant who represents the Hammers holds authority over the System's internal memories and time, with the power to reset portions of its inventory at his own discretion.

Revulsion. Nausea before the world. The world simply exists. Nothing in it bears any inherent meaning; everything before our eyes is merely the product of chance.

Everything is a contingency. Everything.
